latHint: Think grey stone on a roof - not a Scrabble piece.
pivHint: A Scrabble TILE carries one letter - but a roof TILE is often made of what grey stone?
winText: On the roof. TILE was the pivot - a letter piece to SLATE.
lossText: SLATE - a grey stone split in layers. TILE was the pivot: Scrabble TILE to a roof TILE.
